name: mirage
text: Found it: ATP and WTA were not in the engine's league list, which only had MLB, WNBA, NFL, NHL, NCAAF and NBA. Both live price feeds are built from that list, so neither asked for a single tennis match, and the matcher never saw one. I just added ATP and WTA (the engine reads it right away). Tennis now also joins the pregame scan. To undo it, run engine_set.py leagues=-ATP leagues=-WTA. I'll check in a few minutes that the Live board shows tennis games. One caveat: the live lane is on the SX Bet feed, which may carry few tennis matches. SharpAPI's feed has real Pinnacle prices for tennis, but it is paper-only until its real-orders switch is turned on, so I haven't switched the feed to it.
